entries.title: Valheim
entries.definitive_edition: Valheim on Windows PC, with the 1.0 release due September 9, 2026

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original Early Access route, supports the broadest high-end settings/capture setup, and is one of the baseline platforms for the announced 1.0 release. Xbox, Mac, PS5, and Switch 2 are valid routes, but none has sourced exclusive gameplay over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC build through Steam or Microsoft Store/Game Pass. Re-check the same PC route when version 1.0 launches on September 9, 2026.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Early Access PC release with scalable settings and the cleanest high-end capture route.
all_releases.reason: primary: original playable route and best current capture/settings platform.
skip: useful native Linux route, but Windows PC remains the more straightforward capture/support target.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Mac release available through Steam and the Mac App Store.
all_releases.reason: skip: valuable native Mac route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Game Preview console release for Xbox One.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content over PC and lower fidelity than Xbox Series X/S or high-end PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Game Preview console release on current Xbox hardware.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Announced native PS5 release alongside Valheim 1.0.
all_releases.reason: skip: future console route; no sourced exclusive content over PC has been announced.

all_releases.fidelity: Announced Nintendo Switch 2 release alongside Valheim 1.0.
all_releases.reason: skip: future portable console route; no sourced exclusive content over PC has been announced.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Valheim is still pre-1.0 as of June 23, 2026, but PC is both a current playable route and an announced 1.0 platform. Future PS5 and Switch 2 releases are platform-expansion routes, not exclusive-content routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: The current game is still labeled Early Access/Game Preview. Treat PS5 and Switch 2 as announced future platforms until the September 9, 2026 1.0 launch lands.
